environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'org-query-inspection' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on SingleQueryArgument 'department' that blocks requests where the value matches pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|update\s|delete\s|drop\s|exec\s)` with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The custom rule group has a CloudWatch metric namespace 'org/waf/sqli-custom' for monitoring. Rate limiting is set at 2000 requests per 5 minutes per IP.

config.network: ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL 'prod-api-acl' associated

waf_rules.name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
waf_rules.override: all rules set to COUNT (monitoring only)

config.auth: JWT validation sidecar (checks Authorization header only)
